note: written before any test-set metric of s672 or fuse existed; held-out normal check used training-pool normals only

design.preprocess: agnostic: query PCA mask (upstream, threshold 10) computed at 448; references unmasked; 8 rotations
design.mask_672: 448 query mask projected to the 672 patch grid with cv2 INTER_NEAREST
design.fusion: 448 distance grid resampled to the 672 grid with cv2 INTER_LINEAR, weighted mean with the 672 grid
design.map: upstream dists2map(grid, native shape): INTER_LINEAR to native size + gaussian sigma 4; float32
design.image_score: upstream mean_top1p over the configuration grid (zeros on masked background included, as upstream)
design.threshold: shared normal_threshold: linear 95th percentile of the 20 calibration scores, per configuration
design.test_labels: used only by evaluation and post-hoc analysis
